verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Per-call runtime controls and persistence behavior: timeout, memory, CPU, network policy, allowlisted proxy egress, timeout kill/reporting semantics, capped streaming, session-keyed artifacts, and ephemeral local state are all visibly represented, with only the output-to-agent endpoint incomplete.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The board omits the explicit safety invariant that prior-tenant filesystem and process state must not survive reclamation, despite showing destruction, never-repool behavior, and ephemeral local state.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board covers the main request, warm-hit/cold-miss placement, lifecycle, lease enforcement, tool controls, quota admission, quarantine trigger, artifact handling, and monitoring contract. Partial gaps remain around stopped-heartbeat causality, image-release/old-instance retirement qualifiers, the output stream's agent endpoint, quarantine removal from placement, reserved-capacity protection, and supervisor input signals. Weighted coverage is 62.0 of 70.0 (P = 0.8857), which reaches the rubric's 7-level coverage range, but the absent system-defining prior-tenant state-erasure requirement applies the RC cap of 6.
